account.login.browser_code: Your browser is open. Check this code there:
account.login.intro: Sign in to access meetings across your devices and use Pennel Cloud without your own API key.
account.logout.title: Sign out?
account.logout.unconfirmed: You have not confirmed your recovery code yet. You will need it to recover your meetings after signing out. Sign out anyway?
account.sync.title: Sync meetings
account.sync.privacy: End-to-end encrypted: Pennel Cloud cannot read your meetings. Audio stays on this device.
account.sync.confirm_deletes_detail: Pennel will also delete these meetings in Pennel Cloud and on your other devices. They stay in each device’s trash for 30 days.
account.recovery.title: Recovery code
account.recovery.description: Keep this recovery code. You need it to enable sync on another device. Without the code or a signed-in device, nobody can read your cloud data, including us.
account.recovery.vault_reset: The vault was reset on another device. Enter the new recovery code.
account.recovery.lost_detail: Without the recovery code, nobody can read your meetings in Pennel Cloud. You can reset the vault.
account.recovery.reset_detail: This deletes all meetings in Pennel Cloud. Meetings on your devices stay in place and will be uploaded again. Other devices will need the new recovery code.
account.recovery.unconfirmed: You have not confirmed your recovery code yet.
account.recovery.new_detail: The old recovery code will no longer work.
account.devices.title: Devices
account.devices.name: Device name
account.devices.revoke_detail: This device will no longer be able to sync. Existing files stay on it. If you think it was stolen, reset the vault.
account.delete.title: Delete account
account.delete.detail: Your account and all encrypted data in Pennel Cloud will be deleted. Meetings on this device stay in place.
account.claude.title: Claude access
account.claude.help: Let Claude search and summarize your meetings. Claude sends questions to this computer, which answers from the meetings stored here. Your meetings in Pennel Cloud remain end-to-end encrypted. Works while Pennel is open on this computer.
account.claude.connector_help: In claude.ai: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, using this URL:
account.claude.sign_in_help: Claude will then ask you to sign in to Pennel once.
account.claude.connected: Connected. Claude can search your meetings on this computer.
account.claude.error: Cannot connect to Pennel Cloud. Pennel will try again shortly.
account.setup.title: Meetings on all your devices
account.setup.intro: Connect your devices once. Meeting text and templates sync securely; recordings stay on the device where you made them.
account.setup.first_device: This is your first device? Sign in with email to set up your library.
account.setup.new_library: Your account is ready. Create your encrypted meeting library next.
account.setup.locked: Connect a device that can already open your meetings, or enter your recovery code.
account.setup.paused: Sync is paused. Your meetings remain on this device.
account.setup.ready: This device can open your encrypted library. Resume to keep it up to date.
account.setup.backup_help: Keep a copy in a safe place. You can approve additional devices from Pennel; this code is your backup if you lose access to them.
account.setup.backup_missing: Finish saving a recovery code before starting sync. The previous code can no longer be displayed.
account.setup.connected: Devices connected. Pennel is keeping your meetings up to date.
account.link.title: Connect a device
account.link.intro_new: Use a device that already has access to your meetings. Its approval signs this device in and unlocks sync.
account.link.intro_trusted: Open Pennel on your phone and scan this code from Sync & devices.
account.link.scan: Scan with Pennel on your phone. The connection code works for ten minutes.
account.link.confirm: Check that this verification code matches on both devices, then approve.
account.link.phase.awaiting_approval: Approve the connection on this device.
account.link.phase.waiting_approval: Waiting for approval on your connected device…
account.link.phase.expired: This connection code has expired. Create a new one.
account.link.phase.failed: The device could not connect. Try a new connection code.
account.link.lost_help: Another connected device can approve this one. If none is available, you can reset the Cloud library; your local meetings remain.
account.error.unavailable: Device approval is not enabled on this service yet. Use email and your recovery code to connect.
account.error.fresh_code: This connection cannot be used. Create a fresh connection code on your other device and try again.
account.error.expired: This connection code has expired. Create a new one on your other device.
account.error.verify: The connection could not be verified. Check both devices and start a new connection with a fresh code.
account.error.storage: Unlock this device so Pennel can save access, then continue the same pending connection.
account.error.network: The connection was interrupted. Check your internet connection, then continue the pending connection.
account.error.rate: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before checking this connection again.
account.error.device_limit: Your account has reached its device limit. Remove an unused device under Account and device management, then connect again.
account.error.account: Check which account you want to connect. Use a device signed in to that account; sign out here first if this is the wrong account.
account.error.library_changed: Your encrypted library changed during setup. Connect again using a currently connected device or your newest recovery code.
account.error.sign_in: Sign in again to the account you want to use, or connect through one of its already connected devices.
account.error.unlock: Unlock this encrypted library with a connected device or your recovery code. Your local meetings remain here.
account.error.recovery: This recovery code is no longer current. Save the newest code before continuing.
account.error.pending: Finish or cancel the current device connection before changing recovery access.
account.error.cancelled: Connection cancelled. You can start again when you are ready.
account.error.generic: Pennel could not complete this account action. Check your connection and try again.
account.error.incompatible: Update Pennel on both devices to connect. You can also use email and your recovery code.
account.error.service_access: Pennel cannot access the device connection service. Try again later, or use email and your recovery code.
